title: vulneraria barba-jovis
intro: Vulneraria barba-jovis, commonly known as Bearberry or Bear's Foot, is a perennial flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to help manage urinary tract infections and its potential to aid in the reduction of inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its astringent, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which help to soothe and protect the mucous membranes and promote the removal of excess fluids from the body. The bioactive constituents of Vulneraria barba-jovis include arbutin, a glucoside that contributes to the plant's astringent and antimicrobial properties.
